title: Worksheet 3: Normalisation
instructions: Work through the example, then answer the questions in the space provided.

questions.text: Is the relation R(A, B, C) with A → B and B → C in third normal form?
questions.solution: No. C depends on A only through B, a transitive dependency, so R is in 2NF but not 3NF.

questions.text: Give one reason for normalising a database.
questions.model_answer: It removes update anomalies caused by redundant data.
questions.explanation: A short reason the answer is right.
